name: Martial Wraps
body:
Price 2,000 GP (+1), 8,000 GP (+2), 18,000 GP (+3), 32,000 GP (+4), 50,000 GP (+5); Slot wrists or feet; CL 1st; Weight 1 lb.; Aura faint evocation

DESCRIPTION

Coming in a variety of colors, these wraps are meant to be tightly wound around a creature’s limbs, securing them in place. A set of martial wraps comes with enough cloth to cover one set of arms and legs, resizing for larger creatures. A creature wearing these wraps on their limbs gains an enhancement bonus of +1 to +5 on attack and damage rolls with unarmed attacks made with limbs covered by the wraps.

Alternatively, these wraps can grant melee weapon special abilities, so long as they can be applied to unarmed attacks. See Table 3-8: Melee Weapon Special Abilities in Pathfinder Roleplaying Game Ultimate Equipment for a list of abilities. Special abilities count as additional bonuses for determining the market value of the item, but do not modify attack or damage bonuses. Martial wraps cannot have a modified bonus (enhancement bonus plus special ability bonus equivalents) higher than +5. Martial wraps do not need to have a +1 enhancement bonus to grant a melee weapon special ability.

These wraps can also be infused with metal into the cloth, being treated as a light weapon weight 5 lbs. for determining the cost of doing so. If they are infused with a metal, the wearer treats all unarmed strikes as though they were attacks as though they were made of that material, although they can only be infused with a single material.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,000 GP (+1), 4,000 GP (+2), 9,000 GP (+3), 16,000 GP (+4), 25,000 GP (+5); Feats Craft Wondrous Item, greater magic fang, creator’s caster level must be at least three times the amulet’s bonus, plus any requirements of the melee weapon special abilities
